method: Editorial research pass. Queries were assembled from NCSBN and Pearson VUE candidate-facing documentation, state board of nursing accommodation and endorsement pages, CGFNS and NLC/Nursys material, published HESI/ATI predictive-validity studies, and the peer-reviewed literature on chatbot performance against NCLEX-style items. Interest values are calibrated estimates on the Google Trends 0-100 scale, not readings taken from the Trends endpoint — the endpoint was not called for this run. Treat them as a defensible ranking, not as measurements. Re-run with TRENDS_SOURCE=google or TRENDS_SOURCE=csv to replace them with observed numbers.

related: how to get a compact nursing license
keywords.note: Consistently one of the highest-volume post-licensure queries in nursing, and it grew again as Pennsylvania (July 2025) and Connecticut (October 2025) came online. Every candidate hits it the week after they pass, which makes it an 'after' page that catches people at exactly the moment they are deciding where to work. Nobody currently covers the NCLEX-to-compact hand-off honestly — the pages that rank are staffing agencies selling travel contracts.

related: what hesi score do i need to pass nclex
is the hesi harder than the nclex
failed hesi exit exam will i pass nclex
keywords.note: Peaks hard at the end of each academic term when exit exams are sat. High anxiety, high intent, and the searcher is 4-12 weeks from testing — the exact window in which they buy a question bank. The published validity figures are strong in one direction only (a high score predicts a pass; a low score predicts much less), and no ranking page says so.

related: how long does nclex accommodation approval take
keywords.note: Lower volume, but almost nothing written for candidates rather than for boards. The process has one sharp, expensive trap — accommodations must appear on the ATT before scheduling, so booking early voids them — and it is buried in board PDFs. A page that states the ordering plainly is durable, rarely refreshed by competitors, and reaches a group everyone else ignores.

keywords.note: Nigeria is now one of the largest sources of internationally educated NCLEX candidates, and search interest has climbed steadily with it. We already have guides for Filipino and Indian candidates, so this completes the set and inherits their internal linking. The live question nobody answers straight: English is the language of Nigerian nursing education and most boards still demand IELTS or TOEFL anyway.

keywords.query: using chatgpt to study for the nclex
related: is chatgpt good for nclex questions
keywords.note: The fastest-rising study-method query in the category and the one where the ranking pages are worst — they are almost all written by tools selling an AI feature. There is a specific, checkable failure mode in the literature: a general chatbot recommends the clinically reasonable action, which on the NCLEX is frequently the physician's action and therefore the wrong answer. Saying that plainly is both true and differentiating.

probeNote: Each candidate carries a `probe`: the short head term measured in its place. Google Trends will not report on multi-word long-tail phrases — it returns a flat zero for them regardless of the comparison, which means 'below the reporting threshold', not 'nobody searches this'. The probe is the shortest term that genuinely stands in for the candidate and is large enough for Trends to answer about. Where no honest proxy exists the number is unmeasurable and the editorial estimate stands.
